body:
Raids ⚔️
Epic boss encounters with powerful Pokémon and exclusive rewards.

Battle Frontier 🏟️
End-game competitive challenges inspired by the classic frontier experience with customs challenges.

Cobblemon Battle Royale 👑
Last trainer standing. High stakes, high pressure, full chaos.

Dungeons 🏰
Instanced adventures filled with trainers, puzzles, and rare loot.

Dex Rewards 📖
Earn prizes for completing your Pokédex and proving your dedication.

Community Day 🌟
Special boosted spawns, bonuses, and limited-time features for everyone.

Hunts 🎯
Target specific Pokémon and compete to catch the best one.

Battle Pass 🎟️
Progress through tiers, unlock cosmetics, items, and exclusive perks.

Custom Events Every Weekend 🎉
Unique rotating events with special mechanics and rewards.

Ranked Battles 🥇
Climb the ladder, earn prestige, and prove you're the best.

Legendary Spawns ✨
Rare and powerful Pokémon appearing across the world.
